acceptance_predicates.description: An explicit development-live run sends ChatCompletions requests to the selected OpenRouter provider/model for selected agents rather than using a mock or cassette.
Selected/all OpenCode and OpenDesk execution reports bounded progress, provider/model identity, and typed per-run failures.
Missing API credentials or transport failures are actionable live-run errors while setup, signatures, and production key management remain warning-only.
Local/mock remains an explicit credential-free alternative and is never reported as live.

definition_of_done: Exact merged ASB main contains development live run/sweep/fan-out wiring and focused live transport tests.
Hosted PR checks pass at the topology-repaired exact main head.
The evidence records that real provider reachability still requires an operator API key and that public release promotion is separate.

inputs.description: Explicit live mode, selected agents, OpenRouter provider, and supported model.
OPENROUTER_API_KEY supplied by the operator at live-run time.

outputs.description: Bounded human/JSON live benchmark outcomes including provider/model/request status without secrets.

gates.description: Live mode reaches the selected OpenRouter endpoint or returns a typed transport/authentication failure.
No live result is claimed when no provider request was made.
